metadata.name: Shader Art
metadata.description: Animated WebGL backdrop in your theme's colours: a slow, domain-warped liquid field with a soft accent glow that leans towards the pointer, with content on top. Rests off screen, in hidden tabs and under reduced motion; a CSS gradient without WebGL.
metadata.author: konsstepnov
